narrative.en:
The night dealt strange. Fourteen new V4 pools on Uniswap inside ninety minutes — and that is only the ones the scanner caught, the ones that lingered long enough on the felt to be counted. Blocks came one after another like cards off a shoe, and somewhere behind the curtain a hand was not shuffling. It was stacking.

The tell sits in the cluster: six pairs bound to a single hook, 0x0207, every one of them with a 2500 fee and a tick spacing of 1. WBTC/WETH, USDT/WETH, and two tokens whose addresses I did not trouble to memorise — all of it wired to the same hook. Six identical configurations in a row is not a deal, it is a strategy. A liquidity net with a lattice fine enough to place capital to the inch. Why that inch, I do not ask. I only note that nobody builds a lattice by accident.

Then two pools on hook 0x322d, both with zero fee and a tick spacing of 200. One carries a token with something onion-shaped in its name; the other pairs to WETH. A hook that takes nothing is either a laboratory, a way to rearrange the order of execution, or something the house has not yet named.

And last, one pool on hook 0xf583 — fee 10000, tick spacing 200, and a token whose address reads like it was minted minutes ago. Wide step, steep rake: the classic posture of a player who expects little movement and intends to collect rent while the table is looking elsewhere. No conclusions. Only what the felt showed. But if you watch V4, you already know: this was not a night of random initialisations. Someone knows precisely what they are doing. The only open question is which card they mean to play.
narrative.zh:
今夜江湖不静。九十分钟之内，十四口新池在 Uniswap 上开张——而这还只是被扫描到的那些，是那些在台面上停留得够久、被数进来的。区块一个一个过去，像发牌，而帘子后面那只手不是在洗牌,是在叠牌。

破绽在那一簇：六对池子系于同一个钩子 0x0207，费率一律 2500，刻度间距为 1。WBTC/WETH、USDT/WETH，另有两枚代币，地址我懒得去记——全都接在同一个钩子上。六次相同的布置接连出现，那不叫巧合，那叫布阵。这是一张织得极密的内力网，力道可以精确到寸。为何要精确到寸，我不问。我只记下一件事：没有人会无意间织出这样的网。

随后两口池，钩子 0x322d，费用为零，刻度间距 200。一口里那代币的名字，带着几分葱蒜气；另一口对着 WETH。不取分文的钩子，要么是试剑之地，要么是为了挪动出手的先后次序，要么是某种尚未命名的东西。

最后一口，钩子 0xf583，费率一万，刻度间距 200，而那代币的地址看着像刚刚铸成。步子宽，抽头重——这是料定风浪不大、趁众人不备收租的架势。不下断语，只叙事实。但若你也盯着 V4，你已明白：今夜不是随手开局，有人清楚自己在做什么。剩下的问题只有一个——他要打出哪一张牌。

take.en: Fourteen pools in ninety minutes, six of them one identical configuration under a single hook — that is not noise, that is a hand being dealt on purpose.
take.zh: 九十分钟十四口池，其中六口用同一套布置系在同一个钩子上——这不是杂音，是有人刻意在叠牌。

narrative.en: The felt split three ways by midnight, and none of it smelled like ordinary order flow. Six ETH/USDC pairs hit the table with spacing set to one, all inside a 39-block window—26251943 to 26251982, roughly eight minutes—and five different hook contracts, no repeats. That is not a trader testing a line; that is a conveyor belt of configurations, someone counting how many unique mechanisms can be dealt in one pass and, more quietly, why.
narrative.zh:
子夜过后，牌桌分作三处，气息都不像寻常买卖。六对 ETH/USDC 齐齐落座，间距压到一，全在 26251943 至 26251982 这三十九个区块之间，前后不过八分钟；五枚不同的钩子契约，无一重复。这不是侠客试剑，这是有人在山门外摆开流水线，问的是同一口气里能布下多少种阵，更要紧的是，他为何要问。

第二处，五座零费之池，间距二百，其中一边是个无名地址，而钩子都系在同一条契约 0xa6cc4ffa9ebaefd8ab7d3d018b0ae31ec5b760cc 上；三座连着零地址，也就是本门原生 ETH。这更像给同一套门规铺一张内力网——一位管路由的执事，决定哪一对先醒。

第三处，两座池子各用不同代币，却共用一条钩子 0xf6ce7756e6813f259a2b2bcb746f8cf0042fe0cc，在同一区块里开阵：WBTC 与一个无名代币，对着同一个对手。到这一步已不是试手，是照着一个接口，把不同地基接进同一座山门。

最静的一手反而最重：0xcb47459bad70cdb0319b8f9a2c3122beb8624455 与 0xfedc5f4a6c38211c1338aa411018dfaf26612c08 两枚都不在主流名册上的代币，零费，间距二百，钩子 0xc2988a37d611779ad34b561231ee33603d15a0cc。这不是供人进出的流动性，这是基础设施的一层——有人在筑节点，不是在挖池子。牌已摆好，局才刚开。

take.en: The day’s tell is infrastructure, not liquidity: hooks are being assembled as economic primitives while the market watches the felt.
take.zh: 今日最锋利的信号不在池中水位，而在山门骨架：有人已把钩子当作门规来铸，最安静的那座节点才是先手。

narrative.en:
Fourteen new V4 hook pools hit the felt — fourteen, initialized on different blocks, all keeping the same rhythm. Most ask nothing at the door: zero fee, a spacing of sixty, and the same hook contract, 0x15e5e7206c661a1e881f5cd33a94eaf2328fa8cc, breathing in every second pool. ETH-WETH? No — WETH barely sits at this table. The pairs mostly run against the zero address, with tokens whose names end in "6ea," like one family, one cluster, or a dealer handing out a single suit.

Then there is the other hand: block 26244955, a partnership with WETH, spacing 200, and a different hook, 0x322dcec4958c14e021a9f1cd49df11b9457968cc. This is not the same deck. A test, a strategy, or someone deciding to play larger. And at block 26244820, the fee reads 8388608. Not zero. Not standard. A statement.

Look at the pool IDs. They do not read like random hashes; they read like signatures, like tracks. Someone pressed them into blocks seconds apart. Machine? A human with a hot key? Doesn't matter. V4 is already here, and the deck is not being shuffled by hand — it is being shuffled by code. Hooks are not just smart contracts. They are side doors, chances to do what the pool rules never wrote down.

I don't know what tomorrow deals. I know that tonight someone laid the cards out quietly, without noise. Now there is nothing to do but wait for the first move.
narrative.zh:
夜色未散，江湖又起微澜。十四口新池落在不同区块，却踏着同一拍子。多数不收过路费，间距六十；同一枚 hook 合约 0x15e5e7206c661a1e881f5cd33a94eaf2328fa8cc，像同一门派的暗号，隔一口池便出现一次。与 WETH 结伴？不，WETH 几乎不露面；多数池与零地址相对，代币名字都以“6ea”收尾，像同门弟子，也像有人只发一种花色。

另一路却不同：区块 26244955，一口池与 WETH 结伴，间距二百，hook 换成 0x322dcec4958c14e021a9f1cd49df11b9457968cc。这不是同一套剑法。是试招，是另立门户，还是有人准备以内力硬撼，暂且不知。区块 26244820 那口池，费用写作 8388608——不是零，也不是寻常路数。数字像碑上的记号，不是随手刻的。

池的编号也不像散乱哈希，更像暗记、脚印。有人隔着几息就把它们按进区块。是机关，还是手快，已不重要。V4 的门已经开在此处，牌局由代码洗过。Hook 不只是契约，是门规之外的缝隙，是能做池规未写之事的余地。

明日棋局未知。今夜只看见有人不声不响把牌摊在桌面，等第一手。

take.en: The tell is not the fourteen pools; it is the same hook sitting in most of them while a different hook and a non-zero fee wait off to the side like a separate stack. The deck is being shuffled by code, and the first hand has not been played.
take.zh: 真正的信号不在十四口池，而在同一枚 hook 反复落子；另一枚 hook 与一笔不寻常的费用在旁静立，像另一副牌。牌已由代码洗好，先手未出。

narrative.en:
0x322dcec... shows up at the table again, and it doesn't come alone. Six pools in a day, every one with the house's cut set to zero, every one with WETH sitting at one end. When the same hook contract keeps stamping tickSpacing 200 and no fee, that's not an experiment — that's a deal being dealt before the marks even know the game.

0x322dcec... went on a tear: ETH/BTCde... at 26237531, ETH/924885a... at 26237532, ETH/9382f4a... at 26237563, and three more before the ink dried. Eight pools in a day from one hand if you count them all. No fee. Liquidity hasn't walked in yet — the felt is set, the chairs are empty. The question isn't who made them; it's who knows what card comes next.

Other hands weren't sleeping. 0x15e5e720... opened two zero-fee pools — ETH/ed5c03b... at 26237832, ETH/988a0de... at 26237412. Both tickSpacing 60. Small step, tight range. Someone's getting ready for dense trade. And 0x21258f2... took PEPE for a spin: two pools, one on WETH at 26237408, another on 0xd82653... at 26237297, both zero fee, tickSpacing 200. PEPE going two ways — either an arbitrage setup or a shuffle with no tell.

The classics still hold a seat: ETH/983f603... with a 3000 cut, tickSpacing 200, hook 0xcbc1fe9... A bet on stability, not volume. By evening of October 21, Ethereum had 14 V4 pools on the table. Not one with a fee above zero but for a single exception. Hooks are the new back of the deck — whoever shuffles them knows where the next ace lies.
narrative.zh:
0x322dcec... 又现江湖。一日之内六池连开，皆是零费，皆以 WETH 为一端。同一枚钩子合约，tickSpacing 200，分文不取——这不是试水，这是摆宴。内力未至，池已列阵，只等风起。

此合约今日连出八池：ETH/BTCde... 于 26237531，ETH/924885a... 于 26237532，ETH/9382f4a... 于 26237563，此前还有三池。皆无手续费，内劲未注，池水空悬。问的不是谁布下的局，而是谁已知下一张牌。

另有两路侠客未歇。0x15e5e720... 开两池，ETH/ed5c03b... 于 26237832，ETH/988a0de... 于 26237412，皆零费，tickSpacing 60。步小而密，意在近身缠斗。0x21258f2... 则携 PEPE 入局：一池 WETH 于 26237408，一池 0xd82653... 于 26237297，零费，tickSpacing 200。PEPE 两面下注，或为套利，或只是洗牌。

亦有守正者：ETH/983f603... 池，费 3000，tickSpacing 200，钩子 0xcbc1fe9... 不求量，求稳。至十月廿一晚，以太坊江湖共现十四池 V4，除一池外，皆不收分文。钩子已成新门派的面具，谁执此面具，谁便知下一张牌落何处。

take.en: Eight pools from one hand, fourteen on the night, almost none asking a cut — the house is stacking the deck and waiting for the first mark to sit.
take.zh: 一纸钩子合约一日布八池，十四池中几乎全零费——这不是试水，是庄家摆好了牌局，只等第一个入座的人。

narrative.en:
The night's flip of the deck began at block 26230071, when the first hook-bearing pool was shoved into the chain. Nine initializations inside ten blocks followed—not noise, but a pattern with a tell: seven of the nine pit ETH against contracts carrying suspiciously fresh addresses. Only the USDC and USDT pools carry the familiar smell of liquidity, and even those come with hooks hanging off them.

One pool at block 26230235 cuts hardest: token 0x13be...a608 against WETH, zero fee, spacing 200, hook 0x322d...68. Zero fee paired with a wide spread is not a trading desk; it is a different game—data collection, oracle nudging, something with a purpose beyond market making. A hook is always another layer of logic, and when it is fitted to a fresh token with no liquidity, the house is not there to make markets.

Then block 26230550: a pool with a 10000 fee and spacing 200 on an ETH-token pair. A 10000 fee is either a wrapper for a specific strategy or a velvet rope to keep retail out; hook 0x2f17...d040 is plainly not a passive AMM. The deck is being shuffled fast. Someone is testing new logic on V4, using pools as a sandbox. The question is not what these pools do now, but what they will do when liquidity is poured on them. For now they are marks on cards. The one dealing them knows which hand comes next.
narrative.zh:
夜里翻牌，从块高 26230071 开始。第一只带钩的池子被插进链上，随后十个区块里九次开池，这不是风过竹林，是有人按着节拍落子。九只里有七只把 ETH 与地址尚新的合约摆在对门；只有 USDC 与 USDT 那两只还带着旧江湖的流动性气味，可钩子依旧挂在门楣上。

最刺眼的是块高 26230235 那只：代币 0x13be...a608 对 WETH，零费，间距二百，钩子 0x322d...68。零费配宽口，不像做买卖的摊位，更像设来听风、记路，或暗中拨动预言机的秤。钩子从来不是装饰，是把另一层规矩藏进池子；拿它挂在新代币、空内力的地方，便不是寻常做市。

再到块高 26230550，费用一万、间距二百的 ETH 交易对，钩子 0x2f17...d040 明摆着不是那种只被动做市的旧机关。这样的门槛，要么是某种特定招式的鞘，要么是把散客挡在门外的绳。牌桌换牌很快，有人拿 V4 当演武场，先试机关，不问今日输赢。真正的问题不是这些空池此刻做什么，而是等内力灌进去以后，它们会做什么。眼下只是牌面上的记号；发牌的人，已经知道下一手该落在哪只手上。

take.en: The tell is not the empty pools; it is the hooks. Someone is rehearsing a new economic logic on V4, and the first real liquidity will reveal which hand was being dealt.
take.zh: 空池只是记号，钩子才是落子的手。等内力一灌，谁在借 V4 试招，牌面自会说话。

narrative.en:
The deck was dealt so fast last night that I stopped counting the individual cards. Fourteen new V4 pools inside a few hours is not a sprint — it is a heartbeat that has no intention of slowing down.

Seven of them carry zero fee and a spacing of 200, spread across three different hook contracts — 0xb8d9477eb6ef5f0df5219cf0c8130dd7e520e0cc, 0xa6cc4ffa9ebaefd8ab7d3d018b0ae31ec5b760cc and 0xc3774a7456c4cfe8e44d780877c9771d6562e0cc. Three hooks, one template: ETH against the long tail. Somebody is testing how liquidity behaves in real time, and they are not being shy about it. Two more sit under a single hook, 0x322dcec4958c14e021a9f1cd49df11b9457968cc, and the interesting part is the shape of the thing: one binds an unknown token to WETH, the other pairs two tokens where neither is ETH. That is no longer a test. That is a grid being built.

Off to the side, one pool registers a fee of 8388608 — not a typo, a dynamic fee wired to its hook, and 0xe4345ccdb948e57a8440016f2912170e9bcce080 is clearly prepared to play by its own rules. Meanwhile on GitHub a commit lands in launch-1811-build-technical-foundation-hooks, SHA 5033182, no description, no context, just "updated README". If you have been watching this table, you already know what lives inside commits like that: not words, but schematics.

The night itself was quiet. But quiet in crypto is only ever the pause before somebody reshuffles the deck.
narrative.zh:
昨夜发牌太快，快到我不再数单张的牌。几个时辰之内，十四口新的 V4 池子落地——这不是冲刺，是一颗不打算停下来的心跳。

其中七口，零手续费，间距二百，分落在三份不同的钩子契约之下：0xb8d9477eb6ef5f0df5219cf0c8130dd7e520e0cc、0xa6cc4ffa9ebaefd8ab7d3d018b0ae31ec5b760cc、0xc3774a7456c4cfe8e44d780877c9771d6562e0cc。三个钩子，一副模板：ETH 对长尾。有人正在实时试探内力的走向，且毫不遮掩。另有两口同出一门，0x322dcec4958c14e021a9f1cd49df11b9457968cc——形状更有意思：一口将无名之币系于 WETH，另一口两币皆非 ETH。这已不是试招，是在布阵。

侧旁一口池子，费用记作 8388608。那不是笔误，是挂在钩子上的活费；而 0xe4345ccdb948e57a8440016f2912170e9bcce080 这一门，显然打算按自己的规矩行走江湖。GitHub 上亦有一笔提交，落在 launch-1811-build-technical-foundation-hooks，SHA 5033182，无说明，无上下文，只写着 "updated README"。若你一路看着这张桌面，便知此类提交里藏的多半不是字，是图谱。

夜里很静。可江湖的静，从来只是有人要重新洗牌之前的停顿。

take.en: Fourteen pools in a few hours is not accumulation, it is calibration — and calibration always comes before the hand that actually matters.
take.zh: 十四口池子不是积蓄，是校准；而校准，永远发生在真正那一手之前。

narrative.en:
The night of October 18 dealt fourteen new tables on Uniswap V4, all opened inside a narrow window of a couple thousand blocks — and more than half of them posted no rake at all. That is not a coincidence, that is a pattern. The hook contracts have taken the fee into their own hands, which means the standard mechanism for paying liquidity is switched off at the felt. Something else is running the economics — dynamic, external, or simply elsewhere.

Two hooks stand out. 0x784ff9a3ac5d88a30bfff6f7f2a270161fbe6000 sits behind three pools priced at 12500 — one hundred twenty-five hundredths of a percent — while 0x322dcec4958c14e021a9f1cd49df11b9457968cc holds two pools at zero. Same hand, clearly. A third active hook, 0xa6cc4ffa9ebaefd8ab7d3d018b0ae31ec5b760cc, carries three zero-fee pools, every one of them pairing WETH against tokens that do not announce themselves.

And here is the tell: a zero-fee pool is not built for arbitrage. It is built for capturing order flow outright, or for trading that prefers to stay out of sight while the yield is swept up into the hook's own contract. Where the pool charges nothing, the profit moves to the layer of execution — and whoever holds the hook holds the game. A handful of pools pair ETH with tokens that appear on no public listing — 0x845eaf..., 0x07faa4..., 0xc5055b... — the shape of test distributions or private placements. Someone is laying the table before the announcement. First the pool, then the noise.

Fourteen tables dressed, chips placed, dealers at their stations. Now we wait to see who sits down.
narrative.zh:
十月十八这一夜，Uniswap V4 上又开出十四张新桌，前后不过数千个区块的功夫。怪的是，半数以上的桌子不收抽成。这不是偶然，是路数。hook 合约把费率之权收归己手，池子层面那道抽水的机关便等于废了——真正的账，另有一处算。

其中两个 hook 最惹眼：0x784ff9a3ac5d88a30bfff6f7f2a270161fbe6000 掌着三池，费率一百二十五百分之一；0x322dcec4958c14e021a9f1cd49df11b9457968cc 掌着两池，分文不取。出手的显然是同一个人。另有一路 hook——0xa6cc4ffa9ebaefd8ab7d3d018b0ae31ec5b760cc——三池皆零费，且都以 WETH 对着一批来历不明的token。

江湖上都懂：零费之池，不为套利而设。要么是抢单流，要么是暗中过手，把内力尽数导进 hook 自家的经脉里。池面不收，收益便全落在执行那一层——谁握着 hook，谁就握着这局棋的手筋。另有一二池，以 ETH 配着从未见于公开名册的 token——0x845eaf...、0x07faa4...、0xc5055b...——像是试招，也像是私下分派。有人先立山门，再放风声；先有池，后有喧嚣，历来如此。

十四张桌已摆好，灯也点上，庄家各就各位。剩下的，只看谁先落座。

take.en: When more than half the new tables charge no rake, the money is not gone — it has simply moved to whoever owns the hook, and that is the only seat worth watching.
take.zh: 半数新池不收抽成，钱并未消失，只是从池面转到了握 hook 的那只手上——这一手，才是真正该看的位置。

narrative.en:
The felt was already warm when the night cut its first deal, and by the time the blocks stopped moving, seven fresh pools lay face-up on the table — not scattered, stacked. One address keeps coming back to the window: 0x322dcec4958c14e021a9f1cd49df11b9457968cc, four times over, the same hook machinery bolted onto different pairs. Ether against a counterparty that declines to give its name. No cut taken at the door, and the stride set wide at two hundred — not an accident, a system. Somebody is laying out a grid in which the house collects nothing and the space between bets is generous enough for manoeuvre, for arbitrage, for something that hasn't yet shown its face above the water.

The rest of the table is stranger. Pools opened against a zero token — ether paired with addresses that are junk, or nothing at all. Nothing taken at the door there either, and the stride narrow, ten or sixty. Two hook contracts sit in those seats, 0xbbc86e372b758064645e1a4ce958db81e07b68ec and 0x0acca8ed08d2e45e3edb195bddcb0877b21520cc, and no one at the table will say whose they are. They are already playing anyway.

GitHub is not silent either. In the repo launch-1811-build-technical-foundation-hooks a commit arrives signed by IdentityMD Worker — not a man, a process, a hash for a name: ba1d5cc3-e7ed-4fb6-bdcf-87289ff0b534. And PR #11 from surfer77, titled plainly: 'Targeted patch, not a rebuild.' That is the tell. They know exactly which load-bearing wall they are touching, and they have no intention of bringing the house down to fix a door.

None of this is a night of random transactions. It is construction, and it is being done in the open because it does not need to hide. Blocks, hashes, hooks — the shape of a new suit is being cut on the table, and the suit has not been named yet. It has already been dealt.
narrative.zh:
夜半时分，江湖上忽然多出七处新池。不是零星散落，是有人一口气布下的局。同一个地址 0x322dcec4958c14e021a9f1cd49df11b9457968cc 在眼前晃了四次，同一套机关，配的却是不同的对手：以太对上一个不肯报名的门派，抽成归零，步子放宽到两百。这不是随手落子，是有人在地上画格。不取分文，却把间距留得极宽——那是给腾挪留的地，给套利留的地，给那些还沉在水面之下的东西留的地。

其余几处更叫人看不透。池子对面是个空号，以太配着无名废址，同样分文不取，步子却收得极窄，十步，或六十步。两道机关坐在那里：0xbbc86e372b758064645e1a4ce958db81e07b68ec 与 0x0acca8ed08d2e45e3edb195bddcb0877b21520cc，无人识得其主，可它们已经入席了。

山门那边也没闲着。launch-1811-build-technical-foundation-hooks 之中落下一笔，署名 IdentityMD Worker——不是人，是流程，一串 hash 便是它的名号：ba1d5cc3-e7ed-4fb6-bdcf-87289ff0b534。又有 PR #11，出自 surfer77，题名只一句：'Targeted patch, not a rebuild.' 点穴，而非重铸筋骨。他们清楚哪一根梁承重，也清楚不必为了修一扇门而拆掉整座屋。

这一夜的招式都不散乱，是在搭台。新的一门尚未挂匾，内力却已先一步入了场。

take.en: Seven pools, one hook contract repeated four times, two hooks nobody will claim, and a patch instead of a rebuild: this is not noise on the felt, it is a foundation being poured.
take.zh: 同一机关四次落子，两处无主之池开户，山门里点穴而不重铸——今夜值得看的从来不是池子，而是有人正在悄悄立派。

narrative.en:
Thirteen pools in one night, and not one of them smells like accident. The deals land between block 26201755 and 26201940, pressed shoulder to shoulder with no pause from the dealer — the kind of run where you stop counting the hands and start counting the fingers. Address 0xf6b1117... shows up in six of them, zero take on every pot, spacing set at 200 each time. The same suit, repeated, and still no way to tell which card is burned.

The contract 0x322dcec... is the one worth a long look. Seven pools in a row, same hook, different pairs, nothing skimmed off the top. Somebody is collecting — or rehearsing a strategy where each pool is its own page in a book being written in real time. Then 0x0000000000..., two pools against native currency, also hooked, one stepping at 60, the other at 200. Different hands, different grain, as if testing how liquidity behaves when you change the size of the squares on the felt.

And 0x784ff9a... is the only seat at the table charging 12500. It breaks the pattern of zeros. Either it's a marker left on purpose, or bait for anyone who trusts a pattern too early.

Not one familiar name on the tokens. No mainstream house, no known face — every address a clean sheet. Five readings came down in a row, counting backward, tidy as a shuffle. Nobody sat down to trade tonight; they sat down to watch the deck get laid out, face down, before the real game starts.
narrative.zh:
一夜之间，十三口新池落地，彼此紧挨，像同一只手连发的暗器，中间不留换气的空隙。0xf6b1117... 这个名号在六处现身，每一处都不取分毫，价距一律二百——同一路数反复出现，却始终看不清底牌被扣在哪一张。

0x322dcec... 更值得多看两眼。连开七池，同一枚钩子，配对各不相同，依旧分文不取。此人是在收敛藏品，还是在演练一门尚未示人的功法，把每一池当作心法中的一页，边打边写。另有 0x0000000000...，两口以本币为基的池子，同样挂着钩，一处步距六十，一处二百。手不同，格局亦不同，像是在试：棋盘格子换一个大小，内力会往哪里走。

唯有 0x784ff9a... 这一口，收一百二五零零，独自破了零的沉默。是留给人认的记号，还是专为那些太早相信规律的人设下的局，江湖里从无定论。

至于代币名号，一个都不认得。没有名门，没有大派，尽是白纸一张的新地址。另有一串读数自高向低，五步连落，齐整得像刚洗过的牌。今夜无人入场厮杀，只有人坐在案前，看别人如何把牌一张张扣在桌上——真正的局，还没开。

take.en: Nothing was traded tonight worth trading — this was a deck being built face-down, thirteen cards at a time, by hands that don't want to be recognized yet. The only honest position is the chair, and the only honest play is to keep watching.
take.zh: 今夜无战事可言，不过是有人背对着众人排兵布阵，十三池一次，手法尚未露形。此时最稳的一步，是按住不动，看清是谁在发牌。

narrative.en:
The cards came off the sleeve all at once. Sixteen pools in a single evening, and nearly every one dealt by the same hand — that hook contract, 0x322dcec4958c14e021a9f1cd49df11b9457968cc. One dealer, one deck after another, no hesitation between cuts.

I look at the blocks and the gaps are minutes, sometimes seconds. The same block twice in a row, only the tokens change — first a5922c65fe, then 27ce7732ff. Somebody was working the machine without pausing for breath. WETH sits in every other deal, the joker that never leaves the table, the fixed partner for whatever new token walks in. The fee is set to nothing, the spacing locked at two hundred. The stakes were written before the first hand was played.

One pool refuses the pattern: the dead address, token 6e498018fc, and a different hook entirely — b8d9477eb6. That is not a mistake. That is a deliberate play. A test hand, perhaps, or a man deciding he will not wear the house suit.

Every one of these pools is a bare structure. No liquidity, no noise, nothing but the shape of a table waiting for players. Just initialized and standing there. But whoever laid them out knows the game. Sixteen deals in one night is not chaos. That is a strategy. Someone is stacking the deck, shuffling it, and waiting for the moment to throw the trump.

Silence on the wire. But the cards are already on the felt.
narrative.zh:
一夜之间，十六座新门户拔地而起，几乎出自同一只手——同一个 hook 合约 0x322dcec4958c14e021a9f1cd49df11b9457968cc。同一位掌门，立完一山又立一山，中间连换气的功夫都省了。

我看区块之间的间隔，不过数分钟，有时只隔数息。同一个区块连着出现两次，变的只是令牌：先是 a5922c65fe，再是 27ce7732ff。这是熟练的手法，不是初出茅庐的试探。WETH 隔一座便现身一次，像江湖里那位从不缺席的中间人，新来的令牌总要拉上它作保。入门之费为零，间距定死二百。规矩在开局之前就写好了。

唯有一座门户不入此列：空无一物的旧地址，令牌 6e498018fc，用的又是另一套 hook —— b8d9477eb6。这不是失手，是有意为之。或许是试招，或许是有人不肯穿同一件门派衣裳。

这些门户，眼下都是空架子。内劲未注，人气未聚，只是立在那里。但布下这一局的人，显然懂行。一夜十六局，不是乱走，是布阵。有人在攒牌，在洗牌，等一个出手的时辰。

江湖无声，牌已在桌上。

take.en: Sixteen pools, one hand, zero liquidity — this is not a market yet, it is a deck being stacked in plain sight, and the only question worth asking is who is meant to sit down.
take.zh: 十六座门户，一只手掌，内力全无——这还不是市场，是有人在明处攒一副牌；真正要紧的，是谁会被请上桌。

narrative.en:
The deck moved fast on the tenth of October—V4 pools with hooks coming off in packets, like cards from a fresh pack. The same hook contract 0x322dcec4958c14e021a9f1cd49df11b9457968cc showed in nine of fifteen pools. All zero fees, spacing of 200—the standard deal for experiments with custom logic. WETH on one side, unknown tokens on the other.

Two native ETH pools: one through the zero address with token 0x5229d923a678d26f5029bdb40f1e927743ad59c4 on hook 0xb8d9477eb6ef5f0df5219cf0c8130dd7e520e0cc, another with token 0xeeb10007a6d0ef9552eb048bf5fb192264a42099 on the same hook. A third ETH pool carried token 0x00552d041659f25dd4d1a87a38229a4fe9b56776, but the hook changed—0xa6cc4ffa9ebaefd8ab7d3d018b0ae31ec5b760cc.

One pool broke rank: block 26173080, ETH against 0x13b224f8a161d552f5e1b7c82b2183e37815972f, fee 8388608 (0.8% in V4), spacing of 60, hook 0x56f73a2c6d34696eff111fff94addf92a1bc6aec. Someone laid a more aggressive strategy on that felt.

Two pools without WETH: pair 0x0bd58baaaa02866f17ab29db056cb900aa11db86 and 0x72e4f9f808c49a2a61de9c5896298920dc4eeea9 on hook 0x322dcec4958c14e021a9f1cd49df11b9457968cc, and pair 0x2211ff0abe6bd3ae27632888909a3b3b38704475 with WETH on the same hook. All zero fees, all hook-bearing. The picture: a network of pools with identical parameters, only base tokens swapped. Same hook contract means same logic; the only question is what that hook does—dynamic fees, oracles, or something sharper. But the fact stands: fifteen new pools in one day, eleven clones of one template. The deck is being shuffled for real.
narrative.zh:
十月初十，江湖上的牌局开得极快。V4 带钩的池子一批批落下，像新拆的一叠牌。同一个钩子合约 0x322dcec4958c14e021a9f1cd49df11b9457968cc，在十五个池子里出现了九次。全是零费，间距二百，是给自定义逻辑试手的标准盘口。一边是 WETH，一边是未见过的代币。

两个池子用原生 ETH：一个经零地址，代币 0x5229d923a678d26f5029bdb40f1e927743ad59c4，钩子 0xb8d9477eb6ef5f0df5219cf0c8130dd7e520e0cc；另一个代币 0xeeb10007a6d0ef9552eb048bf5fb192264a42099，同一个钩子。还有第三个 ETH 池，代币 0x00552d041659f25dd4d1a87a38229a4fe9b56776，钩子却换了——0xa6cc4ffa9ebaefd8ab7d3d018b0ae31ec5b760cc。

有一个池子不随大流：26173080 那块，ETH 对 0x13b224f8a161d552f5e1b7c82b2183e37815972f，费用 8388608（V4 里的 0.8%），间距六十，钩子 0x56f73a2c6d34696eff111fff94addf92a1bc6aec。出招的人，显然想走更急的路子。

两个池子没有 WETH：一对 0x0bd58baaaa02866f17ab29db056cb900aa11db86 与 0x72e4f9f808c49a2a61de9c5896298920dc4eeea9，钩子 0x322dcec4958c14e021a9f1cd49df11b9457968cc；另一对 0x2211ff0abe6bd3ae27632888909a3b3b38704475 与 WETH，还是同一个钩子。零费，带钩。局面清楚：有人铺开一张同一参数的网，只换基础代币。钩子合约一样，逻辑便一样；只是这钩子究竟做什么——动态费用，预言机，或更深的机关——尚未见底。但事实是：一日十五个新池，十一个同出一模。江湖在换牌。

take.en: The house isn't watching tokens; it's watching the template—fifteen deals, eleven from the same sleeve, and the hook is the only card that matters.
take.zh: 今日最锋利的一刀：不是哪枚代币，而是那张模板——十五池同开，十一池同源，钩子才是内力所在。

narrative.en:
The deal came down overnight and the felt is still warm: fifteen new Uniswap V4 hook pools on Ethereum before the sun bothered to show. Fifteen is a number that means nothing until you sit with it — and fourteen of them carry no fee on the surface at all. The hook contract takes the money; the pool's base cut is a formality. Tick spacing sixty is the house standard for pairs that move, but two tables were set at two hundred, and that says someone is braced for wide swings and has no patience for reshuffling mid-hand.

One seat is playing it old. A pair at 0x384f… against 0xd34a…, a cut of one-eighth of one percent, and a hook contract at 0x784f… that doesn't answer to the same cluster as the rest — an independent hand, maybe. Meanwhile nearly every hook ends in 0cc: 0x348c…0cc, 0xc13c…0cc, 0xdf8e…0cc. That is not luck, that is a script. One factory, one deployer, one signature. The only question worth asking is whose.

Eight of the pools lean on WETH — classic, liquidity tethered to ether. Three don't: 0x1b54… against 0x2447…, 0x384f… against 0xd34a…, 0x4c68… against 0xcabd…. Cross-pair tables, which means someone is building a web of liquidity that doesn't need ether at the center. And the strangest tell of the night: the token 0x1b54e762… shows up three times, three different partners, three different hooks — one base asset, several satellites, each with its own logic.

The card is dated 11 October 2026. A pool with no fee and a custom hook is not a pool — it is a tool. Fifteen tools were laid out tonight, and hooks give their owner a hand on every single swap. Nobody sharpens fifteen blades to test the whetstone.
narrative.zh:
子时刚过，以太坊上便落了十五口新池。十五这个数，本身不算什么，要看你肯不肯坐下来细看。十四口池，面上不收分文——收钱的不是池子，是那枚钩子合约。基础抽成只是走个过场。六十的刻度间距，是江湖里波动之对的常规做法；另有两处设在两百，那是备好了应付大起大落的人，懒得中途挪桩。

席上有一家走的是老路：0x384f… 对 0xd34a…，抽一分二厘五，钩子合约 0x784f… 不在同一脉，许是独行的散人。再看其余钩子，尾数几乎都收在 0cc——0x348c…0cc、0xc13c…0cc、0xdf8e…0cc。这不是巧合，是一套铸模，一个师门，一个落款。值得问的只有一句：是谁。

八口池把内力系在 WETH 上，这是老规矩。另有三口不系：0x1b54… 对 0x2447…，0x384f… 对 0xd34a…，0x4c68… 对 0xcabd…。不借以太而立，说明有人在织一张不以以太为轴的网。最耐人寻味的是 0x1b54e762… 这个名号，一夜出现三次，三次配不同的对手，三次换一枚新钩子——一个根，几处分枝，各自一套心法。

日子是二〇二六年十月十一。不收费的池子配上自定的钩子，那便不是池子，是兵器。今夜摆出了十五件，而钩子在手，每一笔换手都在其掌控之中。磨刀的人，不会一次磨十五把，只为试试石头。

take.en: Nobody lays out fifteen fee-less pools with custom hook logic in one night to run a test — they are building instruments, and the deployer behind that 0cc signature is the only name that matters tomorrow.
take.zh: 一夜之间十五口不收分文的池子，还各配自定钩子，这不是试水，是铸器；真正该盯的不是池子，是那个尾数都收在 0cc 的落款人。

narrative.en:
The night dealt heavy, and the V4 hook flow reads like a man laying out a deck with intent. Fourteen fresh pools inside a hundred and fifty blocks is not appetite — appetite is sloppy, appetite is one pool and a prayer. Fourteen identical gestures is installation.

Watch the pattern. Hook contract 0x322dcec4958c14e021a9f1cd49df11b9457968cc shows up six times: one scheme, run through different pairs — WETH against a handful of small tokens, and a recurring entanglement with 0xd34a99bc0f67ae1bbd63c660e6d0b0dd03e263b7. All of them at zero fee, all with the price granularity set coarse. Nobody builds that combination to catch traders. You build it to hold something else.

Then the tell: a pool initialized against 0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000000. The null address is not a typo at this table, it's a deliberate construction — hook 0xc5cf75480e587f678b8a16b0a7ab15e8715150cc knows exactly what it's doing. You seat the void as a counterparty when you're testing the edges of the machine, or when you're building something that was never meant to pass through an ordinary swap. And one pool breaks the zero-fee liturgy entirely: 0x0f61a3529b5b745657ad0c3626d89c5ed4e1ce57273fa46e0c517c0411a11ae4, hook 0x4d6f947d2c5b7377f7594a0702267c54ffc960c4, charging 12500 — a mechanic that wants its cut at the door, or at the exit.

0xd34a99bc0f67ae1bbd63c660e6d0b0dd03e263b7 is the pivot of the whole hand, appearing across four pools. Someone is stacking liquidity on several fronts at once — a launch, or a migration. None of this is about price. When fourteen pools land in a single night, you don't read the tape, you read the architecture. The deck is being shuffled, and the deal hasn't started yet.
narrative.zh:
夜裡擺開的這局，不像買賣，像布陣。一百五十個區塊之間，十四座新池立起。一時興起的人只會開一座池子試水；連開十四座，是有人在按圖下子。

先看那個身影：hook 契約 0x322dcec4958c14e021a9f1cd49df11b9457968cc，六度現身。同一套心法，換不同的對手——WETH 對上幾個小門派，又反覆與 0xd34a99bc0f67ae1bbd63c660e6d0b0dd03e263b7 纏在一處。手續費一概為零，價格刻度放得極粗。這種組合不是用來接散客的，是用來裝別的東西。

再看那處破綻：有座池子，以 0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000000——空無之址——為幣。這不是手誤，是刻意。守著 0xc5cf75480e587f678b8a16b0a7ab15e8715150cc 的人，清楚自己在做什麼。把虛無請進池中，要麼是在試這套機關的邊界，要麼是在造一件本就不為尋常兌換所用的器物。另有一座池子偏離了零費的規矩：0x0f61a3529b5b745657ad0c3626d89c5ed4e1ce57273fa46e0c517c0411a11ae4，hook 0x4d6f947d2c5b7377f7594a0702267c54ffc960c4，收 12500——進門要錢，或者出門要錢。

而 0xd34a99bc0f67ae1bbd63c660e6d0b0dd03e263b7，是這一局的軸心，四池同現。有人在數路並進地為它鋪內力，像是起壇，也像是遷宗。這一夜看的不是價，是架構。江湖上先修路的人，從不急著趕路。

take.en: Fourteen pools in one night is not trading, it's construction — whoever is laying these rails isn't looking at the price, and neither should you.
take.zh: 一夜十四池，看的不是價，是陣。先立規矩者，後得江湖。

narrative.en:
The deck for the ninth of October dealt fourteen new V4 pools — and those are only the ones I managed to mark before the chain went back to sleep.

The most interesting spread: three pools sitting at zero fee, six carrying the figure 8388608, which in Uniswap's language is a rate that moves on its own, steered by a hook. Contracts 0x322dcec... and 0x56f73a... — the same hand is shuffling both, cutting one with a step of 200 and the other at 60. Different styles, different appetites for volatility.

Watch the pair holding WETH and token 0xef5ddadda1972b799199e20b41eea4aa486c8736 — zero fee, wide step of 200. That is not a scalper's table. That is someone pouring liquidity deep and leaving it there. But the real joker is PR #70 in v4-hooks-public: IndexLpVault, an index LP vault laid over StablePairHook pools. Someone is building machinery to run a basket of stable pairs on rails. And Robinhood Chain — if that is a network and not just a name, we are watching an institutional instrument try to land in a retail ecosystem.

Three pools pair ETH with unknown tokens — a classic deal, cards thrown face-up hoping someone else picks them up. Two pools carry token 0xd34a99bc..., which smells like USDS from Maker, at a fee of 12500 — that is a considered bet, someone wanting to trade a stable pair with a moderate spread. Not one pool with WETH and USDC. Not one classic pair. The whole deck tonight is junk tokens, unknown contracts, and a single vault that could bind them all together. The deck is not fully turned yet. Morning will show who folded and who kept the aces back.
narrative.zh:
十月九日这一局，江湖上又添了十四个新开的池子——而且还只是链上打盹之前，我记下来的那些。

最耐看的一手，是三口不收分文的池子，另有六口挂着 8388608 这个数——在 Uniswap 的地界上，它意味着一门由钩子暗中调息的活费率。0x322dcec... 与 0x56f73a... 两处合约，分明是同一只手在洗牌：一处步幅两百，一处六十。路子不同，对波动的胃口也不同。

再看那对 WETH 与 0xef5ddadda1972b799199e20b41eea4aa486c8736 的池子——零费，步幅宽至两百。这不是给短线客摆的桌子，是有人要把内力埋得深、放得久。可真正的鬼牌，是 v4-hooks-public 里的 PR #70：IndexLpVault，一座架在 StablePairHook 池群之上的指数金库。有人正在修一条能自动调度整篮稳定币对的栈道。至于 Robinhood Chain——若那不只是个名号，而是一方network，那便是想把庙堂的兵器，安进市井的江湖。

还有三口以 ETH 配无名代币的池子，是江湖上常见的散牌，牌面朝上扔出来，等人接手。另有两口带着 0xd34a99bc...（看着像 Maker 的 USDS），费率 12500——这一手是有算计的，想以不厚不薄的点差做稳定币对。整晚没有一口 WETH 对 USDC 的池子，没有一口老派的对子。今夜这一副牌，尽是废币、生面合约，和一座或许能把它们统起来的金库。牌还没发完。天亮时，才看得出谁已经弃牌，谁还攥着底牌。

take.en: Fourteen pools, not one of them a classic pair — the house is dealing infrastructure tonight, not trades, and the only card worth remembering is the vault being built to hold the rest.
take.zh: 十四口池子，竟无一口是正经老对子——今夜庄家发的不是买卖，是地基；真正值得记住的只有那一座正在修、打算把其余全部收拢进去的金库。
